say:1:1041576301:1.text: Really, Sylphira? You turn down an invitation to my banquet only to turn up here at Merlin's?
say:1:1041576301:1.source_cn: 奥菲戈斯，你拒绝了我的宴会邀请，却出现在了梅林这里。

say:2:1041576302:1.text: Don't tell me you've started preferring these dusty bookshelves to my parties!
say:2:1041576302:1.source_cn: 难道说，相比于我的宴会，你现在更喜欢在梅林的居所消磨时...

say:3:1041576303:1.text: Do not be so dramatic. Even I need a change of scenery now and then.
say:3:1041576303:1.source_cn: 别这么说，偶尔也让我换个地方清净一下吧。

say:4:1041576304:1.text: Whenever I attend one of your banquets, you inevitably persuade me into performing.
say:4:1041576304:1.source_cn: 我只要一去你的宴会，不免又会被你怂恿。

say:5:1041576305:1.text: And by the end of the evening, I'm the one playing music without pause while you become the most relaxed guest in the room.
say:5:1041576305:1.source_cn: 结果就是，整场宴会中我一直在不停歇地演奏，你反而成了最...

say:6:1041576306:1.text: Hey, can you blame me? My guests are absolutely captivated by your music. Honestly, you know the melodies of my harp better than I do!
say:6:1041576306:1.source_cn: 谁让我的客人都着迷于你的音乐呢？你可比我都更熟悉我的竖...

say:7:1041576307:1.text: Besides, you weren't alone up there. Didn't Elijah and Lailah dance alongside your performance?
say:7:1041576307:1.source_cn: 再说，你也不是孤零零的一个人吧，伊莱亚和莱拉不是为你的...

say:8:1041576308:1.text: Their coordination was impeccable... though that understanding existed only between the two of them.
say:8:1041576308:1.source_cn: 很有默契的演出，只不过这默契只属于他们两人之间。

say:9:1041576309:1.text: Every step they took landed precisely half a beat slower than the rhythm dictated.
say:9:1041576309:1.source_cn: 他们踏出的每一步舞步都比它应该踏出的时间要刚好慢半拍。

say:10:1041576310:1.text: Hahaha! So the timing got a little messy toward the end. Who cares? It didn't take away from the magic. Everyone was completely spellbound.
say:10:1041576310:1.source_cn: 哈哈，虽然跳到后面节拍是乱了，却无损于你们演出的精彩。...

say:11:1041576311:1.text: Are you certain? I distinctly heard Athalia muttering something about "judgment".
say:11:1041576311:1.source_cn: 你确定吗？我听到阿塔利娅提起了裁决二字。

say:12:1041576312:1.text: Hahaha... Oh, ignore her. Whenever she gets excited, she starts talking about judgments and verdicts.
say:12:1041576312:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈……那只不过是她的习惯而已，她一激动就喜欢说这个。

say:13:1041576313:1.text: Tell you what—next time, I'll make sure Baelran is there.
say:13:1041576313:1.source_cn: 不如这样吧，下次我把巴赫朗叫上。

say:14:1041576314:1.text: He mentioned recently that he tracked down a collection of ancient folk scores. Sadly, the techniques required to perform them have been lost to time.
say:14:1041576314:1.source_cn: 他不久前提起过，他搜集了一批古老的民间乐谱，可惜那种弹...

say:15:1041576315:1.text: We'll invite Talene, too. Once she hears your elegant compositions, she might actually be in a good enough mood to sing alongside you.
say:15:1041576315:1.source_cn: 再请塔琳过来，听到你那优美的乐声，或许心情大好的她也会...

say:17:1041576317:1.text: Of course! My banquets are the finest in all of Esperia, after all.
say:17:1041576317:1.source_cn: 当然不错！我的宴会绝对是伊索米亚最精彩的宴会！

say:18:1041576318:1.text: And a celebration like that simply wouldn't be complete without you.
